mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RESERVATION WHERE TRUNC(CHECKIN) = TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AS TODAY_CHECKIN_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RESERVATION WHERE TRUNC(CHECKOUT) = TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AS TODAY_CHECKOUT_COUNT, (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = '투숙중' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) * 100, 1) END FROM ROOM) AS OCCUPANCY_RATE, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ROOM WHERE STATUS = '청소중') AS ROOMS_NEED_CLEANING, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ROOM WHERE STATUS = '이용가능') AS ROOM_AVAILABLE, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ROOM WHERE STATUS = '투숙중') AS ROOM_OCCUPIED, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ROOM WHERE STATUS = '청소중') AS ROOM_CLEANING, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ROOM WHERE STATUS = '점검중') AS ROOM_INSPECTION, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM HOUSEKEEPING WHERE STATUS = '청소대기') AS HK_WAITING, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM HOUSEKEEPING WHERE STATUS = '청소중') AS HK_IN_PROGRESS, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM HOUSEKEEPING WHERE STATUS = '청소완료') AS HK_COMPLETED, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM HOUSEKEEPING WHERE STATUS = '점검완료') AS HK_INSPECTED FROM DUAL

SELECT C.NAME AS guestName, RT.NAME AS roomTypeName, R.ROOM_NUM AS roomNum, RES.CHECKIN AS checkinTime FROM RESERVATION RES JOIN CUSTOMER C ON RES.GUEST_ID = C.ID JOIN ROOM_TYPE RT ON RES.ROOM_TYPE_ID = RT.ID LEFT JOIN ROOM R ON RES.ROOM_ID = R.ID WHERE TRUNC(RES.CHECKIN) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) ORDER BY RES.CHECKIN ASC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT CS.CHECKIN AS eventTime, '체크인' AS category, R.ROOM_NUM || '호 고객 체크인 완료' AS description, E.NAME AS employeeName FROM CHECKIN_STATUS CS JOIN ROOM R ON CS.ROOM_ID = R.ID LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEE E ON CS.CHECKIN_EMPLOYEE = E.ID WHERE CS.CHECKIN IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT CS.CHECKOUT AS eventTime, '체크아웃' AS category, R.ROOM_NUM || '호 퇴실 처리' AS description, E.NAME AS employeeName FROM CHECKIN_STATUS CS JOIN ROOM R ON CS.ROOM_ID = R.ID LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEE E ON CS.CHECKOUT_EMPLOYEE = E.ID WHERE CS.CHECKOUT IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT HK.COMPLETED_AT AS eventTime, '객실 정비' AS category, R.ROOM_NUM || '호 객실 정비 완료' AS description, E.NAME AS employeeName FROM HOUSEKEEPING HK JOIN ROOM R ON HK.ROOM_ID = R.ID LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEE E ON HK.EMPLOYEE_ID = E.ID WHERE HK.COMPLETED_AT IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY eventTime DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 10
